title: Verify: Keyboard focus and activation unit tests
summary: Unit tests for focus, handleKey and moveFocus
description: Add tests to tests/sceneObject.test.ts and tests/buildScene.test.ts using fake render contexts.

steps.symbol: new: it('activates with Enter and Space only when focused')
